transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Pain in my left flank.
When did you first notice the pain in your left flank?
Started about four, five days ago.
Do you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines that you can tell me about?
No, nothing I know of. My daughter had trouble with pills once.
On a scale of 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain at all and 10 is the worst pain you can imagine, how would you rate it?
Hard to say. I can't put a number on it.
Could you tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have taken recently—including anything new or changed—and the dose if you know it?
I don't take any regular medicines.
Have you had any health problems in the past that you can tell me about?
Another doctor said I have a stone in my left ureter.
Along with the pain in your left side, have you noticed anything else new or different going on with your body?
Yes, I've been feeling sick to my stomach.
Is there anything that makes the pain in your left side better or worse?
Not really noticed. My son drove me here today.
Does the pain stay with you all the time, or does it come and go?
It's just been there, not really coming and going.
What are you most worried about with this pain?
I just want something done about the stone.
Could you tell me what the pain in your left side feels like?
It goes across my back too.
Is there anything else about your past health that you'd like to add?
They said the stone's about 1.3 centimeters.
Is there anything else you'd like to add about medicines, even if only something you take once in a while or have taken recently?
No, nothing at all.
How has your sleep been since the pain in your left side began?
Sleep's not been good, honestly.
Besides feeling sick to your stomach, have you noticed anything else going on since the pain in your left side started?
My grandson came by last week, that was nice.
When you notice the pain in your left side, does it feel more like a dull ache, a sharp stab, or are you not sure?
I couldn't really say what kind.

Besides the stone in your left ureter that the other doctor mentioned, is there anything else from your past health—like other ongoing conditions, past illnesses, operations, or hospital stays—you’d like to add?
No, nothing else I know of.
Besides feeling sick to your stomach, is there anything else you’ve noticed that comes along with the pain in your left side?
Yes, I've been throwing up too.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
